verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents a formal change-management process via 'Behavior change announcements' organized into dated bundles to help users manage disruption, and publishes REST/SQL APIs with OpenAPI specs, which together imply some governance around API evolution. However there is no explicit documentation of API version numbers (e.g., v1/v2 semantics) or a stated deprecation/sunset timeline specifically for its REST/SQL APIs. missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme, formal deprecation/sunset timeline for REST/SQL APIs, independent confirmation of policy adherence.
